# MM-P1-L4-CN01-S2 Fastener inspection and torque - Heat Treat CNC turning center #1
Revision: Rev C
Plant: P1, line P1-L4
Equipment: EQ-P1-L4-CN01

## Scope
This document defines the fastener inspection and lubrication verification procedure for Heat Treat CNC turning center #1 (EQ-P1-L4-CN01). It covers visual inspection, verification of thread engagement, and confirmation of lube refill interval and lubricant part number. For machine operation and safety referencing, see SOP-P1-L4-03, SOP-P1-L4-04, SOP-P1-L4-05.

## Tools
- Torque wrench (appropriate range for machine fasteners; use calibrated tool in calibration program)
- Thread gage set or engagement verification tool
- Clean lint-free rags and inspection light
- Parts cleaner and rust inhibitor as required
- Replacement lubricant: CFW-LUB-477.

## Procedure
- Isolate power and tag out per SOP-P1-L4-03 before any access to guarded areas.
- Open access panels following machine-specific access points in SOP-P1-L4-04.
- Inspect all externally accessible fasteners for looseness, corrosion, stripped heads, and missing hardware. Verify full thread engagement at each joint; note any excessive play.
- If a fastener is found loose, remove, clean the mating surfaces, apply appropriate thread treatment if specified in SOP-P1-L4-05, and reassemble using the calibrated torque wrench. Record action in maintenance history.
- Verify lubricant reservoir and service records. The way lube refill interval for Heat Treat CNC turning center #1 (EQ-P1-L4-CN01) is 40 hours.
- Confirm lubricant part number in the reservoir and stores matches CFW-LUB-477.
- Restore panels and remove lockout following SOP-P1-L4-03. Run functional verification per SOP-P1-L4-04.

## Acceptance criteria
- No fasteners are found loose, damaged, or missing after corrective action.
- Thread engagement is verified and within acceptable fit per manufacturer guidance referenced in SOP-P1-L4-05.
- Way lube refill records confirm adherence to the way lube refill interval for Heat Treat CNC turning center #1 (EQ-P1-L4-CN01) is 40 hours.
- Reservoir contains lubricant part number CFW-LUB-477 and records are updated.
